newsitem.title: FRANCE: Fr Telecom sale to have impact on Havas.
newsitem.headline: Fr Telecom sale to have impact on Havas.

text.p: The chairman of French media group Havas, Pierre Dauzier, said on Thursday the eventual privatisation of France Telecom would have an impact on his company and the telecoms operator could become a significant shareholder in the development of Havas.
"We will be forced to interest ourselves in the privatisation of France Telecom," he said at an investment seminar.
"France Telecom is a relatively important shareholder of Havas," he said. "France Telecom, for us, could become a major shareholder in our development," he said.
